project.name: Hybrid Retrieval & LLM Re‑ranking Engine for Vehicle Search
project.problem: Mobile.de’s current keyword search returns many irrelevant listings, leading to lower conversion and user satisfaction.
project.approach: 1) Index vehicle listings in Elasticsearch and a pgvector store (semantic embeddings from a fine‑tuned SBERT). 2) Use a dense retriever to fetch top‑k candidates, then apply a cross‑encoder (trained on click‑through and conversion data) to re‑rank results. 3) Wrap the pipeline in a LangGraph workflow that can invoke an LLM (e.g., OpenAI GPT‑4) for query expansion and conversational clarification. 4) Deploy via FastAPI, containerized with Docker, orchestrated on GCP Kubernetes, and track experiments with MLflow. 5) Implement automated evaluation (precision@k, NDCG) and observability dashboards (Kibana) for continuous monitoring.

requirements_not_covered: Hands‑on experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch (not listed)
Direct experience with Pinecone, Weaviate or BigQuery Vector Search (candidate uses pgvector)
